text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As enthusiasm continues to build in the lead-up to the Japanese Derby, Symboli Rudolf approaches.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "If you wish to repay your trainer for their trust, then there is no other place more suitable than the Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: These words appear to send Special Week into deep thought.
